text:
alisa: FYI I'm starting a coordinated docs rename across /docs/guides, /docs/sdk, and quickstarts. This will be multi-PR to avoid giant conflicts. Need reviewers and a merge plan.
jamal: +1. Can we get a CI/docs-preview for each PR? Otherwise we risk broken anchors in the site build.
sophie: I can review SDK snippets. Please @mention me on PRs and include local build steps.
kevin: Recommend we do a staggered merge window: move small sections first, then bulk rename. Do merges during low traffic (Sat 02:00 UTC).
docbot: Reminder: docs-preview bot posts a preview URL when the netlify build finishes. Make sure each PR has the `preview` label.
mike: Also we should ship a redirects file so old links don't 404. I'll draft. Example redirect map I used before:
```
# redirects.yaml
- from: /docs/old-sdk/auth
  to: /docs/sdk/authentication
  status: 301
- from: /guides/quickstart
  to: /docs/guides/quickstart-intro
  status: 302
```
kevin: Nice. For anchor changes we should add in-page anchors where feasible and append redirect rules for buggy anchors like `/docs/sdk#old-anchor` -> `/docs/sdk#new-anchor` (Netlify supports fragment redirects via JS fallback).
alisa: Plan: create a master tracking PR (#UI-999) that lists all sub-PRs. Each sub-PR must: include `preview` label, have at least one approver (docs or eng), and include a short checklist. I put a template in the master PR.
sophie: Template idea: checklist items: local build ✅, preview URL ✅, snippet tests (unit) ✅, redirect entry if path changed ✅, notify support if external customers affected ✅.
lena: I'll coordinate QA to spot broken cross-links in the new preview. Can you add the `qa-needed` label when ready?
jamal: For merge ordering: 1) rename non-public internal guides, 2) SDK examples (small PRs), 3) major guide moves with redirect map, and 4) final cleanup PR that removes old files and updates site config.
kevin: Important: avoid merging two PRs that change the same directory at once. Use the staging lock approach: create a tiny merge PR that touches a sentinel file to signal "in-progress". Ping #eng-oncall if blocked.
alisa: I'll open the master tracking PR now and add the initial list. Expect the first sub-PR in ~2 hours. Tagging reviewers: @sophie @mike @jamal.
mike: Quick note: if CI shows orphan anchors in the build logs, add a temporary redirect + a TODO in the PR description to remove after downstream link updates.
docbot: Deploy: docs site preview finished: <https://deploy-preview-1234--docs.redwood.example.com> (this is a mock preview for the test PR).
jamal: Thanks. One more ask — let's keep PR titles prefixed with `[docs-move]` so automation can group them.
alisa: Agreed. I'll also create a small playbook in the master PR for rollback steps in case a merge introduces large regressions (how to revert redirects, re-open old files).
sophie: Sounds good. I'll watch for PRs and do the SDK checks today.
lena: I'll standby for QA signoff once previews are up.
alisa: Great team — posting the master PR link in #docs when ready. Will update thread with sub-PR numbers as they land. :rocket:
